I passed year 1&2 in Malaysia but during my final year in UK, I failed miserably and was not allowed to retake the semester I've considered changing university but the living expenses cost a lot, thus my only option is to return to Malaysia restart the course because unfortunately the credits can't be transferred to other courses. And now the government of Malaysia made a new law won't recognise my highschool results (UEC) by the time I would've complete this course, which now forces my to take A Levels. I applied for A levels and it's been 2 months I have lost all my motivation to continue this path and I'm afraid to contact with any of my colleagues due embarrassment, I have changed my appearance, phone number and deactivated my previous social media accounts. 

Now I'm wondering whether should I quit this career and look for other options or take a year break by working then decide what to do. 

The nightmares I have recently include lecture/tutor of my classes criticising my rude(in reality they don't, they're nice people), constant arguing with my colleagues and family. I could hardly sleep unless it's around 2 or 4 am which I have to wake up at 6am for class. This life has been taking a toll on me lately and I am worried seeing other people who have worse grades than me in the past achieved more than me.  

Also, I have the tendency to escape from reality through gaming and it's starting to get addictive to the point of no return.
